entities.summary: No-Do is the colloquial name for Noticiario y Documentales, a state-controlled series of cinema newsreels produced in Spain from 1943 to 1981 and closely associated with the dictatorial regime of Francisco Franco. No-Do is a film production company in Europe, established in 1943. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
